message: `Holder<a context>` carries an effect, so it does not satisfy `Eq`
fix: pass a type that holds no capability, or drop the `Eq` bound
notes: a type is either part of the world or part of your data (SPEC 10.1), and that is what lets a lambda capture a `T: Ord` without laundering a context (SPEC 10.6)

fix: consume it: `?` to propagate, `match` to handle both cases, `.withDefault(...)` to supply one — or, when you really mean to drop it, the explicit and greppable `.ignore()`
